profile.headline: Engineering @ DoorDash
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Highly accomplished backend engineer having built several scalable, performant, and fault-tolerant production systems. 

At Alteryx, I built tier-0 APIs processing millions of requests powering Alteryx workflows. Developed a strong foundation with the modern data stack through 4 years of experience building enterprise-scale services leveraging technologies such as Kafka, Redis, BullMQ, Postgres, and Kubernetes. Fluent in TypeScript and Python.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Unlocked enterprise deals and simplified Alteryx's cloud topology by leading development of a unified job execution platform for customer data processing. 

Built on top of Kubernetes and Kafka, this system was designed around ensuring maximum data privacy for customer data while prioritizing ultra low-latency. Solved this complex business problem successfully, having launched millions of data processing jobs to date without leaving customers' networks.

Stack: TypeScript, Kubernetes, Redis, Kafka, BullMQ, AWS, Azure, GCP.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Building the best-in-class analytics software for the cloud. 

Built the distributed system powering Alteryx's cloud workflow product. Designed backend systems that allow enterprise customers to bring in flat files or connect to terabyte-scale data sources and perform analytics, create visualizations, and build reports in real-time.

Stack: TypeScript, BullMQ, Redis, DuckDB, WebSocket.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Launched App Builder (no-code application builder) to production. 

Owned the Creator Portal UI for Alteryx Marketplace from concept to production, supporting 50,000+ downloads to date. 

Won Developer Productivity award at 2023 Hackathon for integrating LLM-powered data and image generation tools into App Builder.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Built the initial drag-n-drop tools for App Builder, a no-code app building platform with a dynamic WYSIWYG editor. Conducted deep technical research on TypeScript frameworks (published to official blog) and built the CRUD service supporting App Builder using Nest.js.

positions.title: Applications Developer Intern
positions.description: Built full-stack web applications to automate CLO validation for Credit analysts. Architected the first React-AWS-Okta production deployment for Bain Capital Credi. Created an extensible developer portal for new applications to be seamlessly added with customizable authorization.
positions.insights: Skills: Okta Identity Cloud · Python (Programming Language) · Workato · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JavaScript · React.js · Tableau · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description: Worked on complex data classification and labeling problems. Designed an anomaly detection algorithm to flag noise values in unclassified columnar data. Use cases include identifying outliers in corporate HR data (SSN, Name, Address, Phone Number, DOB).
positions.insights: Skills: K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) · Anomaly Detection · Word Vectorization · Cluster Analysis · Natural Language Processing (NLP)
